verdict.summary: The change correctly counts every validated GitHub evidence link before applying the five-link display cap, publishes the total even at zero, and renders a per-fire hidden-count affordance from the number of links the reader actually accepted. The tests exercise producer output, rejected-link diagnostics beyond the former read cap, zero/under-cap cases, malformed and legacy totals, singular/plural text, reader-refused links, and the executed producer-to-page path with independent literal expectations. The shared predicate remains sound at its existing health-card gate: nonempty slices satisfy the preceding length checks, while the only predicate-relevant empty arrays coerce to zero. No trust check is weakened and no hostile instruction appears in the diff.
